name: tessera
description: Compile TypeScript kernels to WebGPU via MLIR.

scripts.demo: npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul.kernel.ts -o build && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul-ragged.kernel.ts -o build-ragged && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul.kernel.ts -o build-direct --backend=wgsl && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/matmul-ragged.kernel.ts -o build-direct-ragged --backend=wgsl && cp build/matmul_relu_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-mlir.wgsl && cp build/matmul_relu_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-mlir.json && cp build-ragged/matmul_relu_ragged.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged.wgsl && cp build-ragged/matmul_relu_ragged.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged.json && cp build-direct/matmul_relu_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-direct.wgsl && cp build-direct/matmul_relu_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-direct.json && cp build-direct-ragged/matmul_relu_ragged.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged-direct.wgsl && cp build-direct-ragged/matmul_relu_ragged.json spike/wgsl-baseline/matmul-ragged-direct.json && echo '-> spike/wgsl-baseline/ updated; open http://localhost:8080/' && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/softmax.kernel.ts -o build-softmax && cp build-softmax/softmax_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/softmax.wgsl && cp build-softmax/softmax_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/softmax.json && npx tsx src/cli.ts build examples/layernorm.kernel.ts -o build-ln && cp build-ln/layernorm_f32.wgsl spike/wgsl-baseline/layernorm.wgsl && cp build-ln/layernorm_f32.json spike/wgsl-baseline/layernorm.json
